description: This Java class configures a WebClient for downstream REST calls using Reactor Netty. It sets up HTTP client timeouts and provides a bean for WebClient builder.

classes.name: WebClientConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up WebClient with custom HTTP client with timeout settings.

methods.name: webClientBuilder
methods.description: Provides a WebClient.Builder bean for building WebClient instances.

methods.name: httpClientWithTimeout
methods.description: Creates an HttpClient configured with connect and response timeouts, including read and write timeout handlers.

methods.name: connectorWithTimeout
methods.description: Creates a ReactorClientHttpConnector configured with an HttpClient that has specified timeouts.
